# Seedance 2.5 API

> Generate, edit and extend videos using text and multimodal references.

Generate, edit and extend videos using text and multimodal references.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2-5/text-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video` |
| [Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2-5/image-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.5/image-to-video` |
| [Reference to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2-5/reference-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video` |
| [Video edit](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2-5/video-edit.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.5/video-edit` |
| [Video extend](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2-5/video-extend.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.5/video-extend` |

Open a workflow to see its complete input schema, required fields, supported values and request examples.
